blocks.x: Wealth and capital-markets clients buy judgment and pay for experience: advisors need research and portfolio context in minutes, operations need settlement and reconciliation without firefights, and compliance needs evidence without expeditions. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in advisor research and prep, reconciliation and breaks, client reporting, with suitability and disclosure close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
In Capital Markets & Wealth Management, the queues and waits that come up first:

items: Advisors assemble portfolio context from terminals, PDFs and CRM; response quality depends on prep time.
Custody, clearing and fund reconciliation produce breaks cleared by spreadsheet; month-end compresses.
Positions, performance and fees reconcile from extracts; client questions wait on report runs.
HNW records concentrate spear-phishing and exfiltration value; controls are generic, not tiered by risk.
Constrained rebalancing across tax lots hits solver limits; tax-alpha is left behind.
Suitability checks and disclosure packs assembled manually per trade; audit trails thin.

blocks.x: The proof in Capital Markets & Wealth Management is a working system on a real workflow. These are the builds that go live:

items: portfolio context, research and market moves summarized with citations pre-meeting
reconciliation breaks matched and remediated with escalation policy
tax-lot constrained optimization benchmarked across solvers
risk-tiered controls for HNW data with monitoring
